description: home2park is an R package for measuring access from residential buildings to urban parks. The JOSS paper discusses park provision at fine spatial scales, and the own README identifies a city-wide workflow and GPL-3.0 licence. Spatial coverage is the city and building and park layers supplied; temporal coverage follows their map dates, not a time series built into the package. Its metrics can support green-space service or heat-adaptation scenarios by showing which residences have poor park access. A caveat is that geometric access does not capture park quality, accessibility barriers, opening hours or actual use. The package does not simulate heat exposure or mobility on its own. A city model needs separate population and network assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own source were read without obtaining resident locations or computing access.
name: home2park urban park-access metrics
